items.headline: Kumamoto me 5.7 ka bhukamp
items.detail: Japan ke Kumamoto prant me subah 5.7 teevrata ka bhukamp aaya; koi sunami chetavni nahi, ek hafte tak tez jhatko ki aashanka hai.
items.exam_angle: Japan: Ring of Fire par sthit, bhukamp-prone desh.

items.headline: Crimean Bridge par hafte me teesra hamla
items.detail: Crimea ke governor ke anusar is hafte teesri baar Crimean Bridge par hamle ke baad yatayat roka gaya; nuksan ka aaklan chal raha hai.
items.exam_angle: Kerch Bridge: Russia-Crimea ko jodne wala 19 km lamba pul.

items.headline: Hormuz me teen tanker mine se aag
items.detail: Iran ke anusar Hormuz ke poorv me teen tel tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag me ghire; Iran ka daava hai jahaz pratibandhit kshetra me the, swatantra pushti abhi nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz: vishwa tel vyapar ka mahatvapurna jaladmarumadhya.

items.headline: Jeffries pehle Black Speaker ke ummidvar
items.detail: House Democrats ne band matdan me 251-11 se Hakeem Jeffries ko Speaker pad ke liye namankit kiya; 3 January ko poore House me matdan hoga, jeetne par ve pehle Black Speaker banenge.
items.exam_angle: America ke House Speaker: rashtrapati uttaradhikar me teesra sthan.
items.image_credit: Office of Representative Hakeem Jeffries, Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: 2035 tak Islam sabse bada dharm
items.detail: Pew Research ke anuman ke mutabik 2035 tak Musalman aabadi 2.57 arab hokar Isaiyon (2.52 arab) se aage nikal jayegi; unchi janm dar is badlav ki mukhya vajah hai.
items.exam_angle: Pew Global Religious Futures: jansankhya aur dharm ka adhyayan.

items.headline: Ukraine ko EU ka 45 arab euro prastav
items.detail: European Commission ne 2027 ke liye Ukraine ko 45 arab euro ka karz prastavit kiya — 25 arab sena aur 20 arab budget ke liye; chukauti tabhi jab Russia kshatipurti de.
items.exam_angle: EU-Ukraine sahyog aur kshatipurti se judi karz shart.

items.headline: Iran ne hatya sajish ka aarop nakara
items.detail: Iran ne North Macedonia ke daave ko kharij kar diya ki usse jude network ne Greece me ek vyakti ki hatya ki sajish rachi; paanch sandigdh hirasat me hain.

items.headline: IndiGo ki Saudi udanein 30 November tak radd
items.detail: IndiGo ne Jeddah aur Madinah ki udanon ka nilamban bhi 30 November tak badha diya; ab chaaron Saudi shahron ki sabhi udanein 30 November tak radd hain.
items.exam_angle: Khadi suraksha sankat ka Bharat ki udanon par asar.

items.headline: APEC dinner me Trump-Putin mile, Xi bhi saath
items.detail: Shenzhen me APEC swagat ratribhoj me Trump aur Putin ne haath milaya, Xi paas khade the — teeno neta pehli baar ek saath dikhe; Alaska ke baad Trump-Putin ki pehli mulaqat, tri-pakshiya baithak kal.
items.exam_angle: APEC shikhar aur pehli America-China-Russia tri-pakshiya baithak.

items.headline: Israel ka Gaza me naya bhumi abhiyan
items.detail: Israel ne October 2025 yuddhaviram ke baad pehli baar madhya Gaza me Yellow Line ke paschim me bhumi karvai shuru ki; Bureij-Nuseirat ke logon ko ilaka khali karne ko kaha gaya.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram (Oct 2025) aur Board of Peace ki bhoomika.

items.headline: Ukraine ne Xi, Trump se Putin par dabav manga
items.detail: Ukraine ke videsh mantri Sybiha ne kal ki Trump-Xi-Putin baithak se pehle kaha — dono neta Russia par yuddh khatm karne ka dabav banayein, aur bina Ukraine ke koi faisla na ho.
items.exam_angle: APEC aur Trump-Xi-Putin tri-pakshiya baithak — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Board of Peace: Israel-Hamas ne vaade tode
items.detail: Trump ke Board of Peace ne apni doosri report me Israel aur Hamas dono par Gaza yuddhaviram ki shartein na nibhane ka aarop lagaya; report ke mutabik yuddhaviram khatre me hai.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram aur Board of Peace — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Australia ne Israeli basne walon par pratibandh lagaye
items.detail: Australia ne West Bank me avaidh basti vistaar aur hinsa par teen Israeli vyaktiyon aur chaar sangathanon par pratibandh lagaye; Britain ne bhi kal aath nirman companiyon par pratibandh lagaye the.
items.exam_angle: West Bank, do-rashtra samadhan aur pratibandh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Peltola ne Alaska Senate seat jeeti
items.detail: Democrat Mary Peltola ne Alaska me Republican Dan Sullivan ko hara diya; Democrats ke Senate me 56 seat ho gaye — 2009 ke baad sabse bada bahumat.
items.exam_angle: America ke midterm chunav aur Senate bahumat — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Leah Herman, House Creative Services, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: Riyadh me dhamaka, do Houthi missile roke gaye
items.detail: Riyadh me zoradar dhamaka suna gaya, hawai adde ke paas dhuaan dikha; gathbandhan ne kaha do Houthi cruise missile roke gaye, subah ek aur missile bhi roka gaya tha.
items.exam_angle: Yemen, Houthi hamle aur Khadi suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nvidia ne China ko AI chip band kiye
items.detail: Nvidia ne America ki manzoori ke baad bhi Hopper AI chip China bhejna band kar diya; teesri timahi me $2.4 arab ke chip beche the, aage koi shipment nahi hogi.
items.exam_angle: America-China tech yuddh aur chip niryat niyantran — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump China pahunche, Xi ne swagat kiya
items.detail: Trump APEC ke liye Shenzhen pahunche; Xi Jinping ne hawai adde par unka swagat kiya — lagbhag 50 saal me pehli baar kisi Chinese neta ne mehmaan ka airport par swagat kiya, kal tri-pakshiya baithak hogi.
items.exam_angle: APEC, America-China-Russia tri-pakshiya baithak — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran sena pramukh: jawab aur bhi bhayankar hoga
items.detail: Iran ke sena pramukh Amir Hatami ne kaha America ke naye hamle par jawab 'aur bhi bhayankar' hoga aur America ke sahyogiyon ko bhi nishana banayega.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur Khadi suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Xi-Putin mile, bahudhruviya duniya ka vaada
items.detail: APEC ke kinare Shenzhen me Xi Jinping aur Vladimir Putin mile; dono ne kaha Russia aur China bahudhruviya duniya ki ore netritva karenge, aur kal Trump ke saath pehli tri-pakshiya baithak hogi.
items.exam_angle: APEC, China-Russia saajhedaari aur bahudhruviya vyavastha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Takaichi pehli baar China pahunchi
items.detail: Japan ki PM Sanae Takaichi APEC shikhar sammelan ke liye Shenzhen pahunchi; Taiwan par unki tippani ke baad se tanav ke beech yeh unki pehli China yatra hai, Xi Jinping se aupcharik baithak ki sambhavna kam hai.
items.exam_angle: Japan-China, Taiwan aur APEC — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Cabinet Public Affairs Office, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0)

items.headline: Hormuz me ADNOC jahaz par hamla, ek lapata
items.detail: Hormuz se guzarte ADNOC ke jahaz par hamla hua; ek chalak dal sadasya lapata aur 11 ghayal hue, UAE ki tel company ne WAM ko bataya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, Khadi me tel suraksha aur America-Iran tanav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Red Cross: swayatt hathiyaron par niyam banao
items.detail: Geneva me UN bahas ke beech Red Cross ne swayatt hathiyaron par turant kanuni niyam ki maang ki; America, Russia aur Israel bandhan wale samjhote ke khilaf hain.
items.exam_angle: Swayatt hathiyar, CCW aur manavtavadi kanoon — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Etihad, flydubai ne Saudi udanein aur radd ki
items.detail: Etihad ne Riyadh-Dammam udanein 30 November tak aur flydubai ne Riyadh-Abha udanein 27 November tak radd kar di; EASA ne Khadi ki udaan chetavni 31 January 2027 tak badha di.
items.exam_angle: Khadi tanav aur nagrik uddayan suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Sona ek saal ke sabse neeche
items.detail: Sona lagbhag 2% girkar $3,778 prati ounce par aa gaya — September 2025 ke baad sabse neeche; mazboot dollar aur Fed ke byaaj badhane ki aashanka wajah bani.
items.exam_angle: Sona, dollar aur Fed ki neeti — UPSC ke liye upyogi.
